steps.title: Piece moves
steps.body: Each piece moves in its own way. Let's look at the knight, bishop, rook, and queen.

steps.title: Knight
steps.body: The knight jumps in an L shape: two squares in one direction, then one square sideways. It can jump over other pieces.

steps.title: Bishop
steps.body: The bishop moves diagonally, any distance. Each bishop stays on the same colour of square all game.

steps.title: Rook
steps.body: Rooks move in straight lines along files and ranks. Slide the rook from a1 to a8.
steps.hint: Rooks move along a file (a to h) or a rank (1 to 8).
steps.success: Right. Rooks are strong on open files.

steps.question: Which piece moves in straight lines and diagonals?
steps.explanation: The queen combines the rook and the bishop.
